description:
Programme Overview

The University of Warsaw (UW) offers 325 fully funded PhD places across 26 academic disciplines for the 2026/27 session. These are not a separate scholarship scheme but statutory doctoral scholarships: tuition-free education plus a guaranteed monthly stipend for 48 months.

Four Doctoral Schools

  1. Interdisciplinary Doctoral School
  2. Doctoral School of Humanities
  3. Doctoral School of Social Sciences
  4. Doctoral School of Exact and Natural Sciences

Currently 1,700+ doctoral candidates enrolled across these schools.

Financial Coverage

  • Doctoral scholarship guaranteed for 48 months: PLN 4,346 gross/month (before mid-term assessment) increasing to PLN 5,500.50 gross/month (after assessment).
  • Disability certificate holders receive additional PLN 1,071.15/month.
  • Tuition-free: PhD studies at Polish public universities are free.
  • Scholarship to Start: Top 20% of admitted candidates per discipline receive additional award for 12 months.
  • IDUB mobility scholarships: Extra funding for conferences, research visits, and training.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Master's degree or equivalent required.
  • Supervisor nomination required at recruitment stage.
  • International (non-EU) candidates fully eligible.
  • Research proposal and academic achievements assessed, followed by interview (and exam for Exact/Natural Sciences school).

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Applications open (expected)~14 April 2027
Application deadline (expected)~21 May 2027
ResultsJuly 2027
Enrolment and stipend start1 October 2027

Application Process

  1. Create account on IRK portal when admissions open (expected April 2027).
  2. Select discipline and doctoral school; attach supervisor name and consent.
  3. Upload documents: Master's diploma, research proposal, publications/achievements list, CV, language proof, ID/passport.
  4. Pay admission fee (school-wise amount on IRK).
  5. Assessment, exam/interview (May-June).
  6. Results July; enrolment October; stipend starts automatically.

Official Links

  • UW Doctoral Schools admissions: https://en.uw.edu.pl
  • Supervisor search: https://promotorzy.szkolydoktorskie.uw.edu.pl
  • Scholarships portal: https://welcome.uw.edu.pl

Important Notes

  • The 325 scholarships are PhD seats, not a separate scholarship form. Funding is automatic upon admission.
  • 2026/27 round is closed. Next window opens April 2027.
  • Stipend figures are gross; doctoral stipends are tax-exempt in Poland.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 21 May 2027 (Expected). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
